old.name: 🧀 Paški sir — Pag
old.hook: Pag island (3h from Split) · cooperative visits — PDO sheep cheese, sheep graze grass salted by the bura
old.text: Pag island (3h from Split) · cooperative visits — PDO sheep cheese, sheep graze grass salted by the bura The island of Pag (3h northwest of Split) is one of Europe's barest landscapes: stone, wind, sheep. The bura (northeast wind) sprays the grass with constant sea salt that the sheep ingest — uniquely mineralized milk. Paški sir (AOP) is hard-pressed, six months minimum, up to 24–36 months for the best. Visites de fromageries (Sirana Gligora, Sirana Paška) by booking. Buy at the Pazar in Split without having to go up to Pag.

old_also.name: 🥕 Sel de Pag — Solana Pag
old_also.hook: Pag (3h) · salt-pan visit — the Adriatic's historic salt-works · since 999
old_also.text: Pag (3h) · salt-pan visit — the Adriatic's historic salt-works · since 999 Pag's salt pan is documented since 999 AD (one of Europe's oldest still-active salt-works). Production by solar evaporation. Table salt, hand-harvested fleur de sel between June and September. Shop on site, salt-pan tours. Pag salt has its own mineral signature — sea, sun, wind.

old.name: 🔔 Palace at dawn

old.text: 06:30 · Golden Gate → peristyle → substructures · 45 min — the alleys before the cruise-ships Enter through the Golden Gate (Zlatna vrata, north) at 06:30 — outside, Meštrović's colossal Grgur Ninski statue (touching the thumb brings luck, local tradition). old.name: 🏔 Marjan — circuit complet
old.hook: Veli Varoš → 1st terrace → Bene · 2h — 178 ha of pinewoods · hermitage chapels
old.text: Veli Varoš → 1st terrace → Bene · 2h — 178 ha of pinewoods · hermitage chapels From Veli Varoš (stone staircase, 25 steps), climb to Telegrin (175 m, Marjan summit) — passing the chapel of St Nicholas (13th c.), St Jerome (15th c.), St Helena. First panoramic terrace (15 min, palace view), second (45 min, Brač and Hvar view). Down the north side, Bene beach, back via the Sustipan promontory. Plenty of Aleppo pine, rosemary, mastic, with spectacular May–June blooms. Duration 2 h

old_also.text: Foot of Veli Varoš · free — 178 ha · medieval hermitage chapels · panoramic trail Split's green lung. 178 ha of Mediterranean pinewoods (Aleppo pine, cypress, rosemary, mastic), six medieval hermit chapels (St George, St Nicholas, St Helen). Marked trail from the foot of Veli Varoš to the first terrace (15 min, view over city and palace), second terrace (45 min, Brač and Hvar views), zoo at the bottom. Bene beach to the northwest. Cycling possible. When All day · dawn and sunset for the light

old.name: 🏯 Salona — cité romaine
old.hook: Solin (15 min) · archaeological site — 15,000-seat amphitheater, 4th-c. basilica
old.text: Solin (15 min) · archaeological site — 15,000-seat amphitheater, 4th-c. basilica Ancient Salona, the Roman capital of Dalmatia, 5 km north of Split (commune of Solin). 60,000 inhabitants in the 3rd century. Remains: amphitheater (15,000 seats), 4th-c. paleo-Christian basilica, Manastirine necropolis, theater, baths. Vast site, 2h to walk. Combine with an excursion to Klis (high medieval fortress, panoramic view — Game of Thrones filming location, Meereen).

old_also.text: Solin (15 min from Split) · €5–7 — amphitheater, basilica, urban remains 1st–7th c. 5–7 € Ancient Salona (today Solin) was the capital of Roman Dalmatia (1st c. BC to 7th c. Today: amphitheater (15,000 seats), 4th-c. paleo-Christian basilica, Manastirine necropolis, theater. Vast site, allow 2h. What to see Amphitheater · basilica · Manastirine

old.name: 🌊 Bačvice · pointe est de galets · 06:00
old.hook: Bačvice beach · past the last cabin — fishermen mending their nets · no tourists before 09:00
old.text: Bačvice beach · past the last cabin — fishermen mending their nets · no tourists before 09:00 Bačvice beach is Split's icon — fine sand, shallow water, the home ground of picigin (local game: a ball that must never touch the water). At 6am, walk past the cabins east to the pebble point: one or two fishermen mending nets in silence. The sun rises over Mosor (the massif behind), Hvar takes on a rose-ash color. Not a tourist before 9am.

old_also.name: 🏔 Plage Bačvice
old_also.hook: 10-min walk from centre · free — urban sand beach · Dalmatian picigin
old_also.text: 10-min walk from centre · free — urban sand beach · Dalmatian picigin Sand beach (rare in Dalmatia where everything is pebbles), 10 min walk from the center. Shallow water — you can walk 30 m offshore without going over the waist. This is where picigin is played — a Dalmatian beach sport: pass a small ball by slapping the water with the palm, never letting it drop, with diving saves. Croatian intangible heritage sport. A late-afternoon show to watch.

old.text: Ferry Split → Supetar · 50 min — Bol and Zlatni Rat beach Jadrolinija ferry from Split to Supetar (north Brač port, 50 min crossing), bus to Bol (south, 1h). old.name: Brač / Hvar — villas et boutique-hôtels
old.hook: Dalmatian islands · ferry from Split — the real luxury destination is on the islands, not in Split
old.text: Dalmatian islands · ferry from Split — the real luxury destination is on the islands, not in Split Serious Dalmatian-coast luxury lives on the islands. Brač (40-min ferry): Bol and the Zlatni Rat beach, Konoba Tomić and Stina Winery (Bol). Hvar (1h30 ferry): Hvar town (boutique hotels, Michelin-Plate restaurants — Gariful, Macondo), Pakleni archipelago for private boats. old.text: Bus 37 or car · 30 min — UNESCO medieval city on an island 30 km west of Split. Fortified medieval city on a small island, connected by two bridges. UNESCO 1997. St Lawrence Cathedral (portal by Master Radovan, 1240 — Romanesque masterpiece), Kamerlengo fortress, Cipiko Palace, Venetian alleys (Trogir was under Venice 1420–1797). Half a day minimum.
